name: Sailor Element
source:
A world made of human hope, Initium, and a world made of human despair, Finis.
The two worlds existed in different dimension than the human world, and never interacted with each other.

However, one day, the King of Finis, Malm, decided to rule over all worlds.
He hijacked Initium, and finally began to advance into the human world.
"Dia" sent as a vanguard by Malm attacked the humans with his subordinate, "Succubus".
He collected the human life force in order to prepare the appearance of Finis in the human world.

But one day, they are interrupted by two magical girls, Sailor Ignis and Sailor Aqua.
The people of Initium, who had escaped from Finis' evil clutches, turned strong-willed humans into magical girls to stop Finis' rampage.

Dia decides to steal the magical girl's life force, and starts making a plan to corrupt them...

[Translation from the [url=http://herencia.nexton-net.jp/product/sailor_element/story.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
一个由人类希望组成的世界，Initium，一个由人类绝望组成的世界，Finis。
两个世界存在于与人类世界不同的维度，从来没有互动过。

然而有一天，菲尼斯国王马尔姆决定统治所有世界。
他劫持了源，终于开始挺进人类世界。
玛尔姆派出作为先头部队的“迪亚”与部下“魅魔”一起攻击人类。
他收集了人类的生命力，为菲尼斯在人类世界的出现做准备。

但有一天，她们被两位魔法少女——水手伊格尼斯和水手阿库娅打断了。
从菲尼斯邪恶魔掌中逃脱的伊尼腾人民将意志坚强的人类变成了魔法少女，以阻止菲尼斯的暴行。

迪亚决定窃取魔法少女的生命力，并开始制定腐蚀她们的计划……

[翻译自[url=http://herencia.nexton-net.jp/product/sailor_element/story.html]官方网站[/url]]
